request: it should center the 3D view which is a fundamental function in 3D view
summary: Use the built-in 3D view Center view function (threeDView.resetFocalPoint) instead of manual camera math.
analysis: The step hand-rolled camera math (bounding-box center plus manual SetFocalPoint/SetPosition/ParallelScale) instead of performing the 3D view fundamental Center view function. Confirmed in Slicer source that the Center view button (actionCenter, tooltip 'Center view') triggers qMRMLThreeDViewControllerWidget::resetFocalPoint(), whose only real action is d->ThreeDView->resetFocalPoint(), and the official script repository documents threeDView.resetFocalPoint() as 'Center the 3D view on the scene'. The manual math also risks failing its own bounds-based verification, which is why it was flagged.
